Project Title:
Next-Gen Website for KOI SUSHI & THAI & BAR (Ponte Vedra / Jacksonville)

Objective:
Design a professional demo website for Koi Sushi that is modern, brand-aligned, and optimized for both online ordering and reservations. Highlight the restaurant’s identity (sushi + Thai + bar), food imagery, menu, and customer engagement features.

📌 Requirements & Features

1. Hero & Branding

Use images and style cues from the existing site (fresh sushi, sashimi, Thai dishes, bar shots). 
KOI SUSHI

Bold tagline like:
“Fresh Sushi, Bold Thai Flavors & Craft Cocktails — Order Online or Book a Table.”

2. Menu Showcase

Create interactive sections for Sushi, Thai Entrees, Appetizers, Sashimi, Special Rolls, and Drinks — based on the current restaurant offerings and style.

Use the current menu text, descriptions, and imagery (or placeholders styled similarly). 
KOI SUSHI

Include “Featured Dishes” carousels with appetizing visuals.

3. Online Ordering Integration

Integrate the MealKeyway ordering system link seamlessly as the primary CTA on multiple pages:

“Order Pickup”

“Order Delivery”

Floating CTA button “Order Now” that opens the MealKeyway interface.

Ensure the design feels like part of the site (styled button and embedded iframe if possible). 
menusifu.com

4. AI-Powered Reservations Automation

Build an AI booking assistant that:

Lets visitors pick a date, time, and party size

Suggests available time slots

Sends automated confirmation via email/SMS

Handles customer questions like dietary preferences or seating requests

Adds bookings directly to a calendar dashboard

Show an example chat UI: “Hi! When would you like to dine with us tonight?”

AI can reply with real-time confirmations or alternative suggestions if slots are full.

5. Visual & UX Elements

High-quality gallery section (use visuals from existing site where possible). 
KOI SUSHI

Testimonials carousel featuring Google review excerpts. 
KOI SUSHI

Clear contact and location footer (phone, hours, address). 
KOI SUSHI

Responsive layout for mobile ordering & bookings.

6. Additional Enhancements

Sticky navigation with: Home | Menu | Order Online | Reservations | Gallery | Contact

Light/dark mode toggle to match brand aesthetics

Loading animations and subtle micro-interactions for menus and buttons

🛠 Integration Tech Notes (for the developer view)

Online Ordering:
Embed or link directly to the MealKeyway ordering system (provided URL) while keeping customers on the brand domain when possible. 
menusifu.com

Reservation System:
Use AI workflows (GPT or similar) that connect to a backend booking API or Google Calendar API. Provide dynamic time slot availability and email/SMS confirmations.

👇 Tone & Style for AI Studio Output

Modern, clean, and appetizing

Focus on visual food appeal, easy calls to action, and clear paths for ordering + reservations

Professional but warm & welcoming (to match the restaurant’s vibe) 
KOI SUSHI

current koi sushi website - https://www.koiofjax.com/
online ordering system - https://order.mealkeyway.com/customer/release/index?mid=4f4d35546e594a6e76384476393378346e64417045773d3d#/main

**Defining the Project Scope**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the project's scope, aiming to create a modern and professional React application for "KOI SUSHI & THAI & BAR". I've begun outlining the core sections, including a compelling hero section with a strong tagline and clear calls to action. The plan also incorporates interactive menu sections for Sushi, Thai, Drinks, etc., along with a featured dishes carousel and online ordering integration.


**Incorporating Advanced Features**

I'm now fully immersed in integrating advanced features. This includes the MealKeyway ordering system, an AI-powered reservation assistant, and a visual gallery section. Further refinement involves a testimonials carousel and essential contact/footer information. I'm focusing on responsive design, a modern UI/UX with Tailwind, and leveraging the Gemini API for the AI reservation assistant. Finally, sticky navigation is a priority. I've begun establishing the file structure.


**Refining AI Implementation**

I'm currently working to integrate the AI concierge. I'll initially stick with text-based responses for natural dialogue, maybe structuring booking info later. I've set up the `metadata.json` and `index.html` files, with the latter including the Tailwind script. Routing will be handled in `App.tsx`, and `@google/genai` is set up in `geminiService.ts`. I also have specific menu items and the Mealkeyway ordering URL in hand. The AI will handle reservations via a chat component, processing natural language booking requests with mocked backend storage.


**Finalizing the UI/UX**

I'm now focusing on the visual aspects and user flow. The hero section demands striking background images. The AI chat interface needs a professional look, likely anchored bottom-right. Upon confirmed bookings, I'll display a "Booking Confirmed" state. I'm also ensuring standard `enum` usage, `createRoot` in `index.tsx`, top-level `import`, and correct `@google/genai` utilization. Let's make this live!
